name: OpenPod
tagline: Pull the ten minutes that matter — to you.
principle: Black, white, and one blue. The blue only ever marks the moment.

ink.role: foreground on light / background on dark

blue_light.role: accent on white (GitHub light link token)

blue_dark.role: accent on near-black (GitHub dark link token)

accent_rule: Reserve blue for timestamps, deep-links, the jump affordance, and the CTA. Nothing else.

mono.role: product's native tongue — CLI, timestamps, paths, UI labels

signature.rule: Always blue, always a live deep-link. The one visual idea we own.

logo.concept: playhead landing on a position line (jump-to-moment)
logo.clear_space: the height of the playhead triangle on every side
logo.reproduction: one-color first (black / white / blue); full-color is the exception
